name: Orient a model using the viewport control

elements.name: Place the orientation control in the lower viewport corners

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control is in the Top Right position
the user sets the orientation control position to Bottom Right and confirms
the orientation control appears near the lower-right viewport corner
the navigation bar appears above it on the right
the user reopens the orientation control options
the user sets the position to Bottom Left and confirms
the orientation control appears near the lower-left viewport corner
the navigation bar appears above it on the left
the user restores the position to Top Right and confirms
the orientation control and navigation bar return to the right side
